CRITICAL.name: Critical
CRITICAL.description: Requires immediate attention due to severe business impact, safety concerns, or a major service disruption.

HIGH.name: High
HIGH.description: Requires prompt attention due to significant business impact or an approaching deadline.

MEDIUM.name: Medium
MEDIUM.description: Normal business priority requiring attention within standard processing timelines.

LOW.name: Low
LOW.description: Minor business impact with flexible processing timelines.

VERY_LOW.name: Very Low
VERY_LOW.description: Minimal business impact and no immediate processing requirement.

NONE.name: None
NONE.description: No priority has been assigned or prioritization is not applicable.
